meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成 GitHub PR 的代码讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要向同事或客户解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes to non-technical stakeholders

howto.what: 把 GitHub 的代码改动(一个 pull request)变成讲解视频:自动抓取 PR 的差异和提交,规划分镜脚本,生成带字幕的代码编辑器风格视频,片尾列出贡献者头像。全程按步骤执行并检查每步结果,无需人工截图。
howto.when: 当用户给出 GitHub 的 PR 链接、owner/repo#编号,或在已检出的仓库中说“这个 PR”并要求做成视频时触发。仅针对代码变更;其他意图交给 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这个 PR 做一个修复说明视频,用男性配音
say.note: 会按 PR 类型规划分镜,并用指定音色生成旁白。

say.text: 检查当前仓库的这个 PR,做一支新功能揭晓视频

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub PR into an explainer video: fetch its diff/commits, plan the storyboard/script, render a code-editorial captioned video with contributor avatars. Runs step-by-step with checkpoints; no website capture.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user gives a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or says 'this PR' in a checked-out repo and asks for a code-change explainer video. Only for code changes; other intents go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make an explainer video from https://github.com/acme/sdk/pull/1842
say_en.note: Fetches that PR's diff and generates script plus final video.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a fix walkthrough with a male voice
say_en.note: Plans storyboard from the PR type and uses the chosen voice.

say_en.text: Check the current PR and make a feature-reveal video
say_en.note: Converts the diff into a feature-reveal style explainer.
